# H judge the first hour

> Judge an escalation by the receiver's first hour, not by the agent's first message.


## The heuristic

**Judge an escalation by the receiver's first hour, not by the agent's first message.**


_Why:_ Almost all the value and almost all the damage occurs after the transfer. Quality programmes that review the raising message and stop there optimise the paperwork and leave the actual mechanism unmeasured.
